article: For each question, write the correct answer. School Jazz Band Do you play a jazz instrument – maybe the trumpet, guitar or drums? Do you want to have some musical fun with other students in the school (27)…………… have similar interests to yours? If you do, come and join us on Tuesdays after school in the music room. At the moment, there are eight of us playing quite a wide range of instruments. We're having such (28)…………… great time! Mr Jones is an amazing jazz teacher, but we need more people, especially electric guitarists!  We're hoping (29)…………… perform in the end-of-term show and Mr Jones said he’ll arrange the electrical equipment and the sound system, which is great!  Either come and ask me (31)…………… more details during one of the lunch breaks, (32)…………… sign up on the day. But don't forget to bring your instrument! See you there! Sam (from the School Jazz Band)

explanations.27:
原因：定语从句修饰 students，关系代词在从句中作主语，指人可用 who 或 that。
语法点：先行词为 people/students 等表人名词时，定语从句用 who/that 引导，如 “The girl who/that sits next to me is my friend.”
explanations.28:
原因：“have a great time” 为固定搭配，表 “玩得开心”。
词汇点：have a + 形容词 + time，类似如 have a good/wonderful time，强调特定时段的体验。
explanations.29:
原因：“hope to do sth.” 为固定结构，表 “希望做某事”，后接动词原形 perform。
语法点：hope 后接不定式作宾语，不能接动名词，如 “I hope to visit Paris someday.”
explanations.30:
原因：“either...or...” 固定搭配，表 “要么…… 要么……”，连接两个并列动作 ask 和 sign up。
语法点：either A or B，遵循就近原则，如 “Either you or he is wrong.”
explanations.31:
原因：“ask for details” 为固定短语，表 “询问细节”，for 表目的。
词汇点：ask for sth.，如 ask for help/money，强调请求的内容。
explanations.32:
原因：“or else” 表 “否则”，用于警告或建议，此处指 “否则当天报名”。
词汇点：or else=otherwise，如 “Hurry up, or else you'll be late.”
